name: Naoe Saki
source: Yamato's mother and former biker. She takes a subservient tone with her husband when they are alone, referring to him as "Master".[spoiler] In Margit's route it is confirmed she's Kagekiyo sexual slave.[/spoiler] She's very doting towards Yamato and is the type of mother that always see her child as a little kid, in some routes she even feels sad when Yamato "leaves the nest". Got Yamato into raising hermit crabs.
